title: Corroboration orchestrator — ties research, scoring, memory into CorroborationReport pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Loads decision from memory via MemoryManager, extracts rationale text
Calls BraveSearch (via research_tool) with rationale-derived query
Passes findings to score_corroboration, builds final CorroborationReport
Returns Result.ok(report) on success, Result.err(CorroborationError) on failure
MemoryError raised if project or decision not found
